title: fix(insights): user-defined send/bindEvent overrides internal click
body:
in sendEvent, we mark internal events (click and conversion), and prevent them being sent if there was a custom click right before. We also move bindEvent so that it happens _before_ sendEvent

This prevents automatic click when:
- there's a bindEvent child
- there's a sendEvent click before

This doesn't prevent when:
- there's a sendEvent convert before
- there's a view before
- there's two internal clicks in a row

FX-2246
